origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.name: Ko te kaiwhaiwhai
origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.descr: Kua whakangunguhia nga Akori e nga Kariki, he whakapono nui hoki a ratou.
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.name: He kaitākaro
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.descr: Kua whakangunguhia e ngā kaitākaro o rātau tinana ki te tino pai.
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.name: Kaimahi ahuwhenua
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.desc: I whakapaua e rātau he wā e mahi ana i te pāmu a tētahi atu.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.name: Ngā Kaihoko Kaihoko
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.descri: Kua ako te hunga kaihautū i te toi o te hī ika.
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.name: Kaitiaki
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.descrip: Ko te tiaki i ētahi atu me ō rātou taonga utu nui kua whakaako i a rātou kia tiaki hoki i a rātou anō.
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.name: Ka whakaohotia
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.descr: Kaore he tangata ke ki te pouri me te mate kino, ka kawea e te Haunted to ratou raruraru i roto i te puku.
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.name: Kaitiaki
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.desc: Te haere tonu i te tikanga o te whānau o te mahi ki te Ariki, ki te Kawana rānei.
origin.origins_backgrounds.novice_mage.d: I tīmata ngā kaiako ki te whakangungu i raro i te tohutohu a tētahi Kaitoi.
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.name: He kaipuke moana
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.descri: He nui rawa te wā e whakapaua ana e ngā kaipuke ki te whakairo i te papa.
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.name: Ko te kaiwawao
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.descri: Ko to raua aroha anake ko te moana, me te maramara, he maha nga maramara.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.name: Ko te karakia
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.descr: E mahi ana nga karakia ki o ratou atua i runga i ngā huarahi ngaro.
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.name: Kaituhi
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.descri: Ka pahemo nga ngenge o te ringa i te mutunga.
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.name: He hoia
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.descr: Ko te rarangi me te kōnae o te Army o te Ariki.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fresh_face.de: Kāore rāua i mahi i tētahi mea nui.
origin.origins_backgrounds.coalminer.des: Ko nga kohatu katoa o te whenua e hiahiatia ana hei keri, ehara i te kowiri anake.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cryptkeeper.d: He mahi uaua te tiaki i nga urupa o te hunga mate, ina kore e mau tonu.
power.origins_backgrounds.improved_heali: He Whakaora Atu i te Whakaora
Ko te whakaora he 10% nui ake te pānga ki a koe.
power.origins_backgrounds.faster_speed.d: Ka piki ake tō rerenga whenua i te 10%.
Ko ngā kōwhai poaka o te moana
Ka whiwhi koe i te nui ake kai ma te kai i te ika tunu.
power.origins_backgrounds.shield_prowess: Te Mana o te whakangungu rakau
I te whakamahi i te whakangungu rakau, ka whiwhi koe i te Resistance I.
power.origins_backgrounds.hello_darkness: E kore koe e kaha ki te pānga o te pōuri.
power.origins_backgrounds.trusty_hoe.des: Kei a koe he Iron Hoe whakamiharo i tuku atu ki nga whakatupuranga.
power.origins_backgrounds.attack_in_ocea: I runga i te moana, e rua nga tere o ō whakaeke.
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.name: Ko te papanga kanohi
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.descr: Mā te mau i tētahi patch kanohi i te moana tuwhera ka taea ai e koe te pupuri i tō Tirohanga Po.
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.name: Hoki ki o koutou Crypts
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.descrip: Mā tō mōhio ki te hunga mate ka āhei koe ki te ārahi i te 7.5% atu o ngā kino ki te hunga mate.
power.origins_backgrounds.legacy_sword.d: E mau ana koe i te hoari o tō whānau.
power.origins_backgrounds.ore_harvesting: E 5% te tere ake o te keri.
power.origins_backgrounds.paperbacks.des: Whai muri i te tuhi i te maha o nga pukapuka, e toru anake nga pepa e hiahiatia ana hei here i tetahi.
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.name: Ko te Manu Hoko hei Tono
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.desc: Ko te whakahere heihei ki tō rangatira e hoatu ana e koe he wheako takirua.
Ka taea e tō mahi ki te hoari te mahi i te 5% atu o ngā kino i a koe e whakahaere ana i tētahi.
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.na: Ko nga Potions o te Kaihaereere
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: Kua tangohia e koe te maha o ngā rongoā e whai hua ana, e ora ana hoki.
